display.purpose: Brand mark and summary scores only.

cell.purpose: Kanji map glyphs; study-size legibility floor.

label.purpose: Panel titles, status strip, buttons; tracked uppercase.

motion.name: state-feedback
motion.purpose: The only motion in the system; the ticker types once on load.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The focal action; largest filled element on its screen.
components.css: .primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--ground); border: 1px solid var(--accent); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; font-size: 0.75rem; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Hairline container with accent corner ticks.
components.css: .panel { border: 1px solid var(--hairline); background: var(--panel); padding: 1rem; position: relative; border-radius: 0; } .panel::before, .panel::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-color: var(--accent); border-style: solid; } .panel::before { top: -1px; left: -1px; border-width: 1px 0 0 1px; } .panel::after { bottom: -1px; right: -1px; border-width: 0 1px 1px 0; }

components.name: Speaker
components.description: TTS trigger with a visible unavailable state.
components.css: .speaker { width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 0; } .speaker-unavailable { color: var(--ink-dim); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Achievement Ticker
components.description: Locked and unlocked achievement rows; a locked row teaches its requirement.
components.html:
• □ FIRST SESSION
  • ■ CENTURY
components.css: .achievement-ticker { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem 1rem; } .achievement-ticker .locked { color: var(--ink-dim); } .achievement-ticker .unlocked { color: var(--accent-green); }

components.name: Coverage Readout
components.description: Percentage of the clean-slice pool studied, paired with its not-exam-competence sentence.
components.html: 42% OF THE N5 CLEAN SLICE
components.css: .micro-label { font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-dim); }

components.name: Setting Row
components.description: Label plus controls; wraps inside its panel so choice groups never overflow.
components.css: .setting-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }

narrative.overview: Kita renders study as telemetry: a command deck of live readouts around one focal action. Dark-first, hairline grammar, monospace voice, semantic accents. Every number is the learner's own state or an honest zero.
keyCharacteristics: hairline panels with accent corner ticks
monospace single-voice hierarchy via size, tracking, case

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: User accent touches primary action and selection only.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every structural edge is 1px hairline; depth is tonal.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow; state feedback is border and color only.

dos: Do keep every readout live local state or an honest zero.
Do teach with locked and empty panels.
Do pair visual progress with text.
Do theme browser surfaces from the palette.
donts: Don't round past 4px or add glass, gradients, shadows.
Don't let the user accent leak into semantic roles.
Don't ship dead tiles, spinners in content, or kickers.
Don't introduce a second type family or icon font.
